units.source_text: 他的姐夫的自杀使他猝不及防遭受了巨大的打击。

en.t: His brother-in-law's suicide struck him with a tremendous blow for which he was completely unprepared.

units.source_text: 从此之后就连姐姐一家人的生活，他也要负责照顾了。

en.t: From then on, he also had to take responsibility for looking after the livelihood of his sister's whole family.

units.source_text: 对于他来说，未来好似日暮一般日渐昏暗。

en.t: For him, the future grew darker day by day, like the coming of dusk.

units.source_text: 他冷冷的嘲笑自己精神上的破产（他对自己的罪孽和弱点完全了解），继续阅读各类书籍。

en.t: He coldly mocked his own spiritual bankruptcy, fully aware of his sins and weaknesses, and went on reading all kinds of books.

units.source_text: 可是就连卢梭的《忏悔录》也充满英雄的谎言。

en.t: Yet even Rousseau's Confessions was filled with heroic lies.

units.source_text: 尤其是《新生》——《新生》的主人公这种老奸巨猾的伪善者，他可头一次遇见。

en.t: Especially The New Life: never before had he encountered such a sly old hypocrite as its protagonist.

units.source_text: 可是只有弗朗梭瓦·维龙沁透了他的心。

en.t: But only François Villon seeped deep into his heart.

units.source_text: 他在数篇诗里发现了“美丽的男性”。

en.t: In several poems, he discovered a beautiful man.
